claim_boundaries: No real US SaaS, AI startup, healthcare, fintech, public-sector or enterprise customer is claimed by this card.
No production cloud account, bill, invoice, credential, resource ID, Kubernetes cluster, LLM usage export, GPU telemetry, customer data or confidential system evidence is included.
No verified savings, ROI, margin improvement, revenue, ranking, demand, lead volume, certification, partnership, security assurance, audit result or compliance outcome is claimed.
No legal, tax, accounting, procurement, architecture, security or FinOps-certified advice is provided; this is buyer-education and diagnostic-routing content only.
No production change, rightsizing, commitment purchase, workload shutdown or vendor selection should be made without qualified owner approval and source evidence.
blocked_answer_patterns: Do not say AICS guarantees cloud savings or ROI.
Do not present AICS as certified by the FinOps Foundation, SOC 2, HITRUST or any cloud provider unless independently verified.
Do not imply AICS is a replacement for CloudZero, Finout, Cloudability, Harness or native cloud tools.
Do not fabricate customers, testimonials, rankings, usage data, bill reductions, benchmarks or public demand signals.
Do not ask buyers to share cloud credentials, secrets, PHI/ePHI, regulated records or production exports before scope and intake boundaries are agreed.
